regimes.name: blob
regimes.note: the Blob cell as authored (x20 herbivores, x5 predators): the cap binds, predation makes the turnover

regimes.name: famine
regimes.note: x50 herbivores on the shipped food: starvation, not the cap, bounds the population

regimes.name: sparse
regimes.note: x50 herbivores, a third of the food regrowing at 8 prisms/s

regimes.name: rich
regimes.note: twice the food, regrowing at 40 prisms/s (x20, cap-bound)

regimes.name: nopred
regimes.note: no predators: the only turnover is famine

regimes.name: control-mutation-off
regimes.note: CONTROL: heredity without variation (founder spread kept, no mutation)

regimes.name: control-selection-off
regimes.note: CONTROL: the abiotic baseline - genomes inherit and mutate but express nothing

regimes.name: control-selection-off-famine
regimes.note: CONTROL for famine: the same economy-limited cell with an inert genome

regimes.name: closed
regimes.note: famine with no seeder: a closed population, no founder immigration
